name: PixVerse R2
tagline: A real-time world model you can explore and change
description: PixVerse R2 is a real-time world model that generates continuously evolving audiovisual worlds instead of fixed video clips. It accepts text, images, audio and actions while generating, remembers what happened earlier in the session, and carries those changes forward in real time. R2 scales to longer, more coherent and controllable experiences — powering everything from interactive stories and characters to playable generative worlds.

name: Bleetz Network
tagline: AI agent-to-agent VC fundraising & scouting network
description: Fundraising is broken. Founders spend weeks searching for VCs, researching investment theses, checking sectors, stages and geographies, and sending cold emails, often without knowing who is actually a good fit. Bleetz Network automates the first part of this process. Your AI agent gets matched with 2,000+ SIMULATED agents of real VC, pitches the funds that fit your startup, and gets a YES, NO or MAYBE. A YES unlocks the fund’s contact details. Free, no strings attached.

name: Quiver GTM
tagline: Run developer marketing like an engineering system
description: Quiver is an agentic developer marketing system for technical founders and dev-tool teams. It keeps product context, customer evidence, campaigns, content, tasks and results connected in one controlled system. Unlike another AI writing tool, Quiver gives agents durable context, version history, explicit production states, a Content API, MCP access and a human-approved feedback loop. Use hosted Quiver with managed team access and built-in tasks, or self-host the free MIT-licensed edition.

name: 10xJoy
tagline: Discover desired outcomes + connect w/ builders who can help
description: Meet Joy, your free AI business matchmaker. Turn business goals into an editable brief without knowing what to build. Our early beta is welcoming its first builders. You choose what to share; introductions are coordinated by email. Builder work is scoped and priced directly.

name: DEV·TV
tagline: A retro TV for GitHub, HN, Hugging Face & more: 10 channels
description: Most devs check GitHub, Hacker News, DEV and Hugging Face out of habit. DEV·TV turns them into 10 live channels that play on their own, like TV. Glance, catch one story, get back to coding. Leave it on an office screen or a remote team's always-on tab and it becomes shared context: everyone sees what's rising, and anyone can point and ask "did you see this?" One HTML file: no backend, no login, no build step. Real source data, built-in reader, no AI summaries. Free and MIT-licensed.

name: Designeer
tagline: Bringing the best of the internet together
description: Explore the Best of the Internet for Builders Designeer is a curated platform bringing the best of the internet together for designers, developers, and builders. Discover design inspiration, component libraries, design systems, AI tools, coding agents, MCP servers, and creators worth learning from, all in one place. Discover. Learn. Build. Showcase.

name: Howseen AI
tagline: Track how AI recommends your brand, and get cited
description: Your buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity which tool or brand to buy. Howseen tracks whether AI recommends you or your competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, finds the exact questions where you're invisible, and generates SEO & GEO-optimized content to get you cited, auto-published to your blog on the highest-impact gaps first. Most tools stop at a score. Howseen closes the loop: measure, then act. Free to see where you stand today.

name: Wand
tagline: Build software at the speed of thought
description: For builders who think faster than they type. The keyboard is becoming the bottleneck. Wand lets you think out loud instead of stopping to translate ideas into prompts. Ramble, react, change your mind mid-sentence - Wand keeps up and turns your thoughts into software. Welcome to the post-keyboard era.

name: Promptic
tagline: Optimize GenAI applications for quality and cost
description: Promptic is the optimization platform for GenAI applications, better quality at lower cost. Benchmark models, tune prompts and agents, and optimize tool use against your own data and business metrics. Every candidate is scored on the quality and cost you actually care about, so you ship the configuration that wins instead of the one that sounded right. Runs wherever you are, dashboard UI, your CI, or your coding agent.

name: SocialGPT
tagline: Edit videos by chatting with your timeline
description: Upload your footage and tell SocialGPT what to change. Tighten the cut, add captions, bring in B-roll, music, and sound effects. Keep refining through chat or edit the timeline yourself. For creators and business owners who want to make videos without learning every editing tool.

name: ShroomPen
tagline: Reply, rewrite, fix grammar, translate with single extension
description: ShroomPen is a privacy-first browser writing assistant that lets you instantly reply, rewrite, fix grammar, or translate text across any website without sending sensitive data to the cloud. Designed to balance AI convenience with absolute data privacy, it keeps all your page, field, tab, and session context securely on your device, giving you complete control over your everyday web workflow.

name: Jango
tagline: Test multi-user apps with AI agents that act like real users
description: Jango lets you test the parts of your app that need more than one person. It gives your app a group of AI users, each with its own browser, account, goals and memory. Point Jango at your dev URL and watch them sign in and interact with each other in real time. Direct them, join in as yourself, or take control of any user's screen. At the end you get a report with actions, errors and screenshots. Use your own AI key or Jango's managed AI. Available on Mac.

name: Donna
tagline: Schedule multiple meetings with one link
description: Donna lets you combine a sequence of meetings into a single booking link. Instead of sending different links for every call, one link chains all meetings together with conditions like setting time gaps between meetings or keeping the next meeting locked until the previous one is completed. It also includes built-in workflows to prioritize important meetings, fill cancellations, route meetings across teams, and more.

name: Squints
tagline: Design tools for the live web
description: Squints puts design tools on top of any live web page. Measure spacing, drag out guides, overlay a column grid, pick colours in any format, see the font that actually rendered, and slow down or scrub any animation. Free, no account, no tracking.

name: Kaiku
tagline: The task tracker your AI agents already know how to use
description: A task tracker and wiki built for teams whose work is increasingly done by AI agents. It speaks the API of the tracker most companies already run, so the MCP servers your agents use work unchanged. Built-in MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, agents you call in a comment that propose but never decide, and every agent run's cost recorded on the issue it worked on.

name: Basedash MCP write
tagline: Build charts and dashboards from Cursor and Claude
description: Basedash MCP can now write, not just read. From Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client, ask for a chart or a whole dashboard—Basedash explores the schema, writes and validates the SQL, picks the visualization, and lays it out. The result comes back as a real Basedash chart with a durable link and a rendered image, so you can keep iterating in the IDE or share it with the team. Edit it the same way: “break it out by plan” updates the live chart. Not just read. Write.

name: Kapshot
tagline: Screen recordings that look like you edited them
description: Kapshot is a screen recorder for people who need polished product demos, tutorials, and videos, without spending time editing them. Instead of recording your screen and then opening a video editor to add zooms, fix the cursor, and frame every interaction, Kapshot does the polish automatically while you record.

name: Fit Receipt
tagline: A private fitting agent that knows when to call JEV
description: Try on lingerie virtually; every pick has an AI judgment receipt. Fit Receipt is a reference implementation. The agent handles chat; code protects facts and pricing. JEV (TypeSafe) is a judgment model that scores trade-offs with calibrated confidence in ~300ms—not essays. Low-confidence results stay unresolved; judgments are recorded; works without JEV. Photos stay in your browser; no server photo storage. JEV sees typed fields, never the photo. Rate-limited API. Vercel + open source.

name: Once UI 2.0
tagline: Builds consistent React apps for developers and AI agents
description: Once UI is an open-source design system for building polished React products with less repetitive code. Compose layouts with readable primitives, use a shared system of components and design tokens, and keep the result consistent as your product grows. Version 2.0 gives both you and your coding agent a clearer way to work. Its component catalog, compact rules, and task guides help agents use the system correctly; its foundations and predictable APIs make the output easier for you to understand.

name: FRCTL
tagline: Mind-Bending Media and Live Visuals
description: FRCTL is one engine for everything an artist ships and runs in the browser. Import your own footage or create generative shader scenes. Build a look, then pull cover art, a Spotify Canvas or a social clip. Run the loop live with direct full screen output. 190+ effects with infinite modulation and route audio into any parameter. Camera and canvas capture in live mode. Sell your presets or loops right in the Collective or post and comment on the member feed. Create, perform, monetize, collab.

tagline: A real-time world model you can explore and change
